textRuns.value: KPI definitions: New users = users with a session numbered 1 that day. Returning users = active users that day who are not new. Both are daily distinct counts, so the shares are shares of user-days, not of distinct users. Channel mix = share of sessions by channel, grouped from traffic_source medium. Device split = share of sessions by device category. Limitations: channel is the user's first-touch source in this dataset, not the session's, and Other collects every medium not listed. Sample data from a different organisation; not CMRD users.
